sources.name: Otsu Ministry of Justice registry-map parcels (2026, selected public-coordinate sheet 401)
sources.operator: 法務省 / Ministry of Justice; G-spatial Information Center distribution
sources.identityRecipe: JP-MOJ-2026-OTSUSI-{published inner sheet filename without .zip}-{native 筆/@id}. Native sheet and parcel ID, municipality and edition namespaces; no geometry or order derived identity.
sources.identityStabilityLimit: Pinned 2026 archive only; continuity across revised sheets or editions is unverified. Do not merge overlapping geometry identities.
sources.archiveHashBasis: Retained discovery full-archive hash; current runtime checks selected nested-sheet SHA-256, exact ranges, archive byte length and ETag. No whole-archive fetch.
sources.scope: Partial Otsu: only official 2026 sheet 25201-1600-401, 191 parcel records in the observed envelope 135.86216–135.86469 E, 35.00708–35.00958 N. Other 419 sheets are outside the enabled scope. No coverage at the WUP locator or citywide completeness is claimed. Registry map dates and accuracy vary.

projection.operation: Inverse Japan Plane Rectangular CS VI Transverse Mercator, latitude origin 36, longitude origin 136, scale 0.9999, GRS80; JGD2011-based geographic coordinates displayed as WGS84 without a fitted shift or grid.
projection.datumClassification: Root 測地系判別=測量. This is not a datum realization; JGD2000/JGD2011/epoch and any TKY2JGD conversion details remain second-pass uncertainties.

jurisdiction.basis: Official MOJ CKAN identifies 大津市 registry maps under Real Property Registration Act Article 14(1)/(4); selected native XML identifies municipality 25201 and public coordinate zone 6.
